envelope.description: Connect controller review to the same task coordinator

body.title: Connect controller review to the same task coordinator
body.summary: Add controller assignment/result exchange over the same admission, result validation, checkpoint and CR contracts. Preserve actual other-party routing and the explicit disconnect distinction; leave full multi-worker integration to S3.
acceptanceChecks: Controller-built code routes to daemon review; daemon-built code routes to the actual controller. Caller-provided party labels cannot bypass that selection.
Controller receives one assignment at a time and submits ordinary feedback through daemon validation/writes; a valid result returns the next assignment or completed metadata.
An identical accepted submission replay is idempotent; wrong-party/task, conflicting replay and missing-checkpoint requests produce actionable errors without mutation.

Controller disconnect retains completed tasks and stops its unfinished execution; daemon reviewer work outlives the submitting request. Explicit recovery selection remains S2, actual session-thread integration/concurrency cleanup remains S3.
Equivalent assessments on both routes produce equivalent status, scoped results and CR content, with actual reviewer provenance retained.

tests.name: controller parity: actual independent-party routing and equivalent assignment/result/CR semantics
controller submissions: replay idempotency, conflicting/foreign result refusal and missing-checkpoint errors
review disconnect: stop controller work and retain completed tasks while daemon reviewer outlives submitter
